author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Territory Studio
summary: A studio in London since 2010. It designs screen graphics and interfaces as part of a story world.

hero_image.alt: A long studio with a built control-panel prop on the bench, sheets of screen-graphic layouts and component drawings laid out, two people working at the far desks.
hero_image.caption: Screen graphics made as a physical prop first: the interface has to exist before it can be filmed.
